notes.title: We're not dead!!
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31653099/b328618a503b5a24d8a3885adb398e26f91c5ed1.png[/img]It has been about a year since our last announcement, but that does not mean changes are not coming. Our small team experienced a major loss in the family last year that greatly affected our day to day lives. But we are back, and that means so is our work on Fat Foods! We have been hard at work redesigning and adding new features to Fat Foods.

[h1]Future features will include:[/h1]
[list]
[*] 8 stages, each containing 3 levels. There is now a story to the game that 
    will play out over 24 levels. Every stage will have a boss battle in the 
    third stage that is themed to each stage.

[*] Unique character movement: The game will no longer center on 
    a character that rolls around the levels, but will instead focus more on 
    platforming. The current working version of the game allows the character 
    to walk, run, and jump; but at the press of a button, the player will tuck and 
    roll, allowing them to move faster.  (alpha content - all images subject to change)

[url=https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31653099/9da35c73d57bce3207c47ba4e02b5e65411fedf4.png][img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31653099/7eed43066fc609746071628c790c6c0f68c5cb04.png[/img][/url]  [url=https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31653099/064efa4ebfe77079850f1b3f4f17d97081258992.png][img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31653099/ac1b1856f7b38fe2de7d798b7e9bb9a7d009244c.png[/img][/url]  [url=https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31653099/c4ab8d2ea2162a6d6b611f3e4fdf77253b55a24d.png][img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31653099/3276b1bc6b50e4b3697672d0186975c87faad114.png[/img][/url]

[*] New character abilities: The main character of Fat Foods will hove be able 
    to double jump and butt-slam by default, but throughout the game, the 
    player will unlock other abilities as well.

[*] The levels themselves will now contain NPCs that will interact with the 
    player as they move about the world.

[*] [b]Overhauled Multiplayer[/b]: That is right! We will be adding local and 
    online multiplayer to the game. We will still have the giant game-play mode 
    that is already in the game, but there will also be a co-op mode as well as 
    a competitive multiplayer mode.
[/list]

[h1]    Keep an eye out for future updates and releases.[/h1]
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31653099/5629e2b1af67906fde259546f1ecf6c4ee6bdb4b.png[/img]

notes.title: Update January 24th
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31653099/89c376a28a7c14256cd823cb1be9b5bfee07eb65.png[/img]
Fat Foods should now be available in all regions for purchase! 

* The Main Menu has been update with the active levels getting a face-lift.

* All player cameras now contain all the control info needed to play.

* We are still working on Vive and WMR support.

Please contact us here on Steam or email support@team21studio.com with any questions or concerns.

Thank you from everyone at Team 21!

notes.content:

[h1]As of 6 am EST Fat foods is now live![/h1] We fixed some minor bugs leading up to the release, and we have moved onto adding more levels and content that should start being seen over the next few weeks.
